Permissions required by samples/pim-eligibility.entra.json (mode: app, 8 resource(s))

Microsoft Graph application permissions
  AdministrativeUnit.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/administrativeUnits/EMEA Staff
      (provider)
  Directory.Read.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupEligibilityScheduleRequests/460c2c78-3d8e-570a-86a5-9f60311f3d74
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupEligibilityScheduleRequests/b86139ae-e5db-5733-88a5-7febc874bc01
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/50c35af8-2e11-598f-99fe-b17a8a765544
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/63bb5daf-46fa-54ed-890f-fb8923d57034
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/ad1dd55a-ac83-5c91-99ac-da5fec494dff
      (provider)
  Group.ReadWrite.All
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/pim-helpdesk-admins
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/pim-ops-responders
      (provider)
  Organization.Read.All
      (every deployment)
      (preflight: GET /organization)
  PrivilegedEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.AzureADGroup
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupEligibilityScheduleRequests/460c2c78-3d8e-570a-86a5-9f60311f3d74
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/privilegedAccess/groupEligibilityScheduleRequests/b86139ae-e5db-5733-88a5-7febc874bc01
      (provider)
  RoleEligibilitySchedule.ReadWrite.Directory
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/50c35af8-2e11-598f-99fe-b17a8a765544
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/63bb5daf-46fa-54ed-890f-fb8923d57034
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/roleEligibilityScheduleRequests/ad1dd55a-ac83-5c91-99ac-da5fec494dff
      (provider)
  RoleManagement.ReadWrite.Directory
      /providers/Microsoft.Entra/groups/pim-helpdesk-admins
      (provider)

note: Application permissions are Microsoft Graph app roles granted (with admin consent) to the service principal EARM signs in with (AZURE_CLIENT_ID, or the managed identity). Application.ReadWrite.OwnedBy replaces Application.ReadWrite.All for applications the service principal owns.
note: Optional, not listed above: User.ReadBasic.All (or a broader user or directory read such as User.Read.All or Directory.Read.All) lets every online run read the tenant size right after the preflight (GET /users/$count) and pace Graph requests with the tenant's directory budget; without it the run goes on with the smallest tenant's budget (3,500 resource units per 10 s), which only makes a large deployment slower.
note: Edge permissions are listed for every relationship property the template declares (including an empty array, which removes edges). Key Vault access is an Azure RBAC / access-policy requirement of the signed-in identity, not a Graph permission.
